gloss: going to bed; retiring for the night

definitions.gloss: going to bed; retiring for the night
definitions.explanation: The act of going to sleep, often used in formal or institutional contexts.

examples.japanese: {就寝|しゅうしん}{時間|じかん}は10{時|じ}です。
{就寝|しゅうしん}{前|まえ}にスマホを{見|み}ない。
examples.english: I don't look at my smartphone before bed.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{規則|きそく}では{起床|きしょう}は6{時|じ}、{就寝|しゅうしん}は10{時|じ}だ。
examples.english: According to school rules, wake-up time is 6 o'clock and bedtime is 10 o'clock.

notes:
{就寝|しゅうしん} is a formal word for going to bed or retiring for the night. It is more commonly seen in written language, schedules, and institutional settings than in casual conversation.

COMPOSITION:
{就|しゅう} (to take up, to settle into) + {寝|しん} (sleep).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {就寝|しゅうしん}{時間|じかん}: bedtime
- {就寝|しゅうしん}{前|まえ}: before bed
- {就寝|しゅうしん}{中|ちゅう}: while sleeping

CONTRAST:
- {就寝|しゅうしん}: going to bed (formal)
- {寝|ね}る: to sleep, to go to bed (everyday)
- {起床|きしょう}: waking up, getting up (formal opposite)

REGISTER:
Used in schedules ({起床|きしょう}6{時|じ}、{就寝|しゅうしん}10{時|じ}), hotel and dormitory rules, health advice articles, and formal writing. In conversation, {寝|ね}る is the natural choice.
